question: Which country hosted the Asian Athletics Championship in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qatar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Qatar** hosted the **Asian Athletics Championship in 2019.**
 
• **China** emerged as the **overall champions of the Asian Athletics Championship 2019, **securing 59 medals, including **23 gold, 20 silver, and 16 bronze.**
 
• Athletes from **44 countries **across Asia participated in the championship, competing in a variety of track and field events.
 
• The **mascot** of the Asian Athletics Championship 2019 was the** "Falcons of Qatari Heritage,"** representing the speed and grace of the falcon, a significant symbol in Qatari culture.
 
• The championship witnessed record-breaking performances, such as** Bahrain's Salwa Eid Naser **setting** a new championship record** in the women's **400 meters **and **Japan's Yuki Hashioka achieving the same in the men's long jump.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Qatar FIFA World Cup 2022:**

 
 
• **The FIFA World Cup 2022**, hosted by **Qatar**, attracted over **3.4 million spectators** and set a record with **172 goals​.**
 
• **Argentina won** the tournament,** beating France **in a thrilling final that saw notable performances from** Lionel Messi and Kylian Mbappé​.**
 
• The tournament had a significant online engagement, with **nearly six billion interactions globally​​.**
 
• The event's** mascot was La’eeb **and the official theme was** "Hayya Hayya (Better Together)" **performed by **Trinidad Cardona, Davido, and AISHA​​.**
